SELECT s.sid, m.mname, h.hname, s.show_time, s.end_time, s.price, s.seat_count, s.remaining_seats, h.row_capacity FROM screening s JOIN movie m ON s.mid = m.mid JOIN hall h ON s.hid = h.hid WHERE s.is_deleted = 0 AND remaining_seats > 0
AND m.mname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{portalVo.keyword}, '%')
AND DATE(s.show_time) = STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT(#{portalVo.date, jdbcType=DATE}, '%Y-%m-%d'), ' %'), '%Y-%m-%d %')
ORDER BY s.show_time

SELECT * FROM screening s WHERE s.is_deleted = 0
AND s.mid = #{portalVo.id}
AND DATE(s.show_time) = STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT(#{portalVo.date, jdbcType=DATE}, '%Y-%m-%d'), ' %'), '%Y-%m-%d %')
ORDER BY s.show_time
